_comment: Opinionated rule overrides for DevOps work. NOT YET LOADED — claude-code-hook reads its rules from src/rules.ts in v0. Once v0.2 lands rule-file loading (~/.agentgate/rules.json or AGENTGATE_RULES_FILE), this file will plug in.
name: devops-agent-default
description: Opinionated overrides for safe DevOps/MLOps work on top of the built-in rule set.

tier_overrides._comment: Disable noisy categories by default; re-enable per-team

always_allow: _comment: tool-call patterns that are explicitly safe in this agent's context
always_ask: _comment: things that even auto-policy should never auto-approve
always_deny: _comment: never allow these even with approval (use deny if a 'no' policy decision is correct)

approver_constraints._comment: Constraints on who can approve what (planned for v0.2 with multi-tenant)
